people_visible: young couple
event: He lifts her off the ground indoors
notes: He has swept her off her feet mid-laugh in a student room. Unguarded and young - one of the best possible openings for Chapter 1.

people_visible: The father seated indoors, laughing, with dozens of small jewel stickers stuck all over his bald head and face; a daughter's hands are reaching in to place more, and the mother stands beside him
event: The girls decorating dad's bald head with rhinestone stickers while he sits and takes it
notes: Completely unrepeatable: dad's shaved head covered in gem stickers, hands still working on him, everyone laughing. Indoor light is mediocre and it doesn't matter.

people_visible: Father standing chest-deep in clear turquoise water with both arms raised, the three daughters hanging off him and floating around him
event: Playing in the sea, the father hoisting all three girls at once
theme: Fatherhood; Vacations; Humor; Family of five
notes: Arms up in triumph with a daughter clamped to each side and the youngest floating in front in pink armbands — genuine, physical joy. Bright water, clean exposure, holds the screen easily.

people_visible: Father in sunglasses in a low-angle selfie with all three daughters piled around him; the youngest drinking from a cup, one girl in a 'Best Sister' shirt
event: Sitting outside together, the girls crowding into a selfie
notes: Four faces stacked at different depths and none of them arranged — the toddler drinks straight through the photo and the eldest leans in laughing. Messy, warm and unrepeatable.

people_visible: father, older daughter, newborn
event: At home on the couch
notes: Dad holds the newborn while the big sister holds her doll in the same pose. Accidental and lovely.

people_visible: The couple lying on a carpeted floor among confetti and beer cans, heads together, laughing
event: The aftermath of a party - streamers and confetti all over the carpet, drum hardware and cymbal stands in the corner, cans on the side table
notes: Collapsed on the floor at the end of a party, still holding on to each other and laughing - the debris around them tells the whole story of the night. Same party as S049.

people_visible: father, daughter
event: Backyard
notes: Dad sprawled in a lawn chair, daughter in a tiny chair copying his exact pose. Genuinely funny - Chapter 5.

people_visible: The father and the youngest daughter side by side, both sticking their tongues out and crossing their eyes for the camera, in a busy shop or ice-cream counter
event: Silly face-pulling selfie with a striped drink cup on the counter beside them
theme: Humor; Fatherhood; Everyday life; Growing together
notes: Father and daughter pulling identical goofy faces, tongues out — the mirroring is the whole point and it lands. Busy background, but the two of them dominate.

people_visible: Close-up of one daughter in red plaid pajamas with her mouth wide open in surprise, an adult in a Christmas sweater seated beside her at the edge of frame
event: Reacting to a gift on Christmas Eve — caught mid-gasp
notes: Pure unguarded reaction shot: eyes wide, mouth open, caught the exact instant. Indoor light is warm and slightly soft but the expression carries it.

people_visible: The mother in a cap reading MOM of GIRLS, cheek to cheek in a selfie with a beaming daughter wearing a rainbow candy-bead necklace
event: Outdoor selfie of mother and daughter, the girl grinning with a candy necklace on
notes: Enormous open-mouthed grin from the daughter against her mother's cheek, and the cap literally spells out the household. Bright natural light, tight crop.

people_visible: father, mother, toddler daughter
event: At home, couch
notes: Toddler face fills frame, dad grinning underneath, mom leaning in. Unposed and alive - exactly the everyday register the film needs.

people_visible: father, mother, young daughter
event: Formal event at home before going out
notes: Parents dressed formally, small daughter photobombing at knee height. Funny and true - a strong Chapter 5 candidate.

people_visible: Father laughing in the foreground with all three daughters behind him, the baby wide-mouthed with laughter at bottom
event: Arm's-length selfie on the couch at home, everyone laughing at once
theme: Fatherhood; Sisterhood; Home; Humor; Family of five
notes: Four open-mouthed laughs in one frame, the baby's the biggest of them. Soft, slightly washed-out phone image, but the feeling is completely unforced.

people_visible: The couple on the sports field, facing each other; her back to camera in a white jersey numbered 11, he in a white t-shirt pulling a face
event: Joking around on the sideline of her lacrosse game, teams lined up in the background
notes: Hard-dated 23 April 2000 and completely unposed - he is gurning at her mid-conversation with her number 11 filling the frame. Same day as S006.

people_visible: The mother reclining in a patio chair reading a handmade card, with a young daughter in a swimsuit beside her, mouth open mid-shout
event: Mother reading a card from her daughter on the back porch while the girl reacts
notes: Wholly unposed: the mother is actually reading the card while the daughter yells something at her from a foot away. Dim porch light and awkward framing, but the moment is real.

people_visible: Father in a black 'Ken' T-shirt with three daughters in Barbie-print tops crowded around him in a kitchen
event: A Barbie-themed party, apparently a birthday, at home
notes: The dad wearing a 'Ken' shirt to his daughters' Barbie party is the whole joke and it lands; the toddler is pressed into the middle of the huddle. Kitchen clutter visible at the edges.

people_visible: Father lying back in shallow pool water lifting the toddler daughter overhead; two other figures, one appearing to be the older daughter, are in the water behind them
event: Play in a shallow pool - the father launching the toddler into the air
notes: Unusual overhead-into-water composition; the child is mid-air with legs kicking. The background figures are too small to identify with certainty.

people_visible: father in a beanie and a young girl in a red crocheted hat, both sticking their tongues out in a selfie
event: father-daughter clowning selfie, outdoors in winter clothing
notes: Both of them pulling the same face at arm's length - the relationship is the whole photo. Awkward selfie crop and blown-out background.

people_visible: father with a girl on his shoulders, a woman in an elf costume, a man dressed as Santa, and a woman holding a small child
event: an in-home Santa visit - Santa and an elf posing with the family by the fireplace and tree
notes: A hired Santa and elf standing in the living room with the family - an unusual, very datable holiday ritual. Busy, dim room and a bit of a lineup composition.

people_visible: Mother, father in a flat cap, and two young daughters in matching pyjamas at a party table; a shop worker in a red apron and other guests behind
event: Birthday party at a doughnut shop, one daughter balancing a doughnut on her head while the other reaches for the whipped cream
theme: Holidays; Milestones; Humor; Family of four
notes: A doughnut is balanced on one daughter's head and her mouth is wide open with glee while the other reaches into the cream. Balloon tablecloth, doughnut cake stacks, both parents laughing behind them.

people_visible: One daughter lying spread-eagle on the grass holding a lacrosse stick, above the letters A E C spelled out on the field in lacrosse balls
event: Goofing on the field after practice, having spelled out initials with the ball bucket
notes: Overhead composition with the balls spelling initials and the girl flopped starfish-style above them; the most inventive single frame in the sports run.

people_visible: The two younger daughters in matching grey camp shirts and stick-on bear ears, each holding a basketball, with face paint on their noses
event: Basketball camp in a school gym, the two of them mugging with balls held up
notes: Bear ears, painted noses and two enormous grins in an empty green-and-gold gym. Genuinely funny and clearly a camp day rather than a posed portrait.

people_visible: young couple
event: On a couch at a gathering
notes: Piled together laughing on a couch, drinks in hand. The college years exactly as they were.

people_visible: The father in a white tank and the mother in a pale tank top
event: Sprawled together laughing in the back seat of a car
notes: COUPLE ALONE, completely unposed and laughing in a car back seat - very high emotional value. Faded, colour-shifted print with a blown-out flash.

people_visible: The mother in a Santa hat and a young daughter in white dragging a cut fir tree toward camera, the father at right holding the saw aloft, and one more person behind them
event: Cutting down a Christmas tree at a tree farm and hauling it out of the rows
notes: Mid-action frame: the tree is down and being dragged, the father is brandishing the saw like a trophy. A fourth figure behind the tree is too obscured to identify.

people_visible: The whole family in Halloween costumes indoors: the father in a football uniform with face paint, the mother in a patterned outfit with a red headband, and the three daughters costumed, the youngest wearing a sash and carrying a trick-or-treat bag
event: Halloween night, posed in costume before trick-or-treating
theme: Holidays; Family of five; Humor; Home
notes: All five in costume in one hallway frame, dad committed all the way to face paint; the annual Halloween lineup with everyone still willing to participate.

people_visible: mother and father in costume posing together in a living room beside a decorated Christmas tree
event: a costume or themed party at home in December - COUPLE ALONE, both mugging for the camera
notes: COUPLE ALONE - the two of them in matching daft costumes in front of their own Christmas tree, clearly enjoying themselves. Ordinary indoor phone exposure but a rare, funny frame of the parents off duty.

people_visible: The father in a Titans #33 jersey and a long dreadlock wig, with the mother in a referee's striped shirt
event: Halloween costume party outside a brick bar, red cup in hand
notes: COUPLE ALONE in Halloween costumes; the burned-in stamp gives 10.27 but the year digits are unreadable at scan resolution. Funny, distinctive and well lit.

people_visible: Two daughters leaning over a car seat back with their faces close to the lens; the father grinning between the headrests behind them
event: Goofing around in the car, faces crammed into a selfie
notes: A grey headrest blocks the bottom third and the exposure is flat, but the squeezed-shut eyes and the father's grin behind make it genuinely funny. Keep despite the technical mess.

people_visible: The father and all three daughters at a dining table under HAPPY B-DAY balloons, the girls wearing hair towels and robes, a plate of pastries in front of them
event: A birthday morning at home — spa-style hair towels, robes and a pastry on the table under the balloon letters
notes: Dad squeezed in among three girls in towel-turbans; the domestic silliness of a birthday-morning routine reads clearly.

people_visible: The father in a red tee, sunglasses and a green 'GOT BEER?' novelty hat, with the mother in a green striped top and green beads
event: St. Patrick's Day, the two of them squeezed together indoors in green gear
notes: COUPLE ALONE, hard-dated by a burned-in stamp reading 03.17.2007 - the single cleanest date/occasion match in the batch. Very heavy red flash cast.

people_visible: The older daughter alone, jumping with arms flung wide, backpack on, beside the 'first day' sign
event: First day of school - the older daughter leaping in the driveway
notes: Caught mid-jump with both feet off the pavement, which sells the excitement better than the posed frames from the same morning. Distant framing, motion-soft.

people_visible: Father balancing on one leg in the living room following a video on the TV, with both daughters copying the pose behind him
event: Following an exercise or dance video at home, all three mid-pose in front of the television
theme: Fatherhood; Home; Humor; Everyday life; Chaos
notes: Furniture pushed aside and a screen-led workout in the living room - very much spring 2020 at home. Motion blur on the girls, which suits it.

people_visible: young man singing
event: Karaoke / singing with a microphone
notes: Mid-song with a microphone, entirely committed. Good comic beat for Chapter 5's tone even though it predates the marriage.

people_visible: Father holding the youngest daughter, mother beside him, and two daughters in cheerleader costumes, in front of a house and minivan; the adults in matching team outfits
event: Halloween in coordinated sports-team costumes before trick-or-treating
notes: A whole-family themed costume in the driveway, plastic pumpkin buckets already in hand. Snapshot lighting but the group coordination is the point.

people_visible: one girl, about 3, sitting cross-legged on the carpet surrounded by scattered board games and papers
event: a child has emptied every board game box across the family room floor
notes: The wreckage of a dozen game boxes with one small culprit sitting calmly in the middle of it. Wide, plain snapshot but the story is complete in one glance.

people_visible: The couple in a car, both in white caps; she wearing glasses at the wheel, he leaning into frame from below
event: About to drive somewhere; self-taken arm's-length snapshot in the car
notes: An arm's-length selfie taken on film, which is itself a period marker - they had to pay to find out it worked. Both grinning straight down the lens.

people_visible: father, mother
event: 30th birthday party (30 balloons)
notes: Backyard party with 30 balloons and inflatable palms. Useful as a dated marker and for the growing-older thread.

people_visible: Father in a cap and sunglasses holding the toddler daughter, who is working on an ice cream cone, with the older daughter posing arms-out beside them
event: Ice cream stop outside a storefront
notes: The toddler's ice-cream-smeared face and the older sister's theatrical pose carry the frame. Bright direct sun, faces partly shadowed by the cap.

people_visible: Mother and father in a street selfie; he is wearing a white cap, aviators and a costume-style jacket with a false moustache look
event: Halloween, the parents in costume outside on the street
notes: Both are clearly enjoying the bit; the costume is the joke and the parked cars and pavement place it mid trick-or-treat. Sharp and well exposed.
